_comment: Pure-logic profile (like mock.json) that ALSO loads the Challenge-2A arena map (NAV-2). `arena_name` points at finals/configs/arenas/sample.json, which config._resolve_arena loads into cfg.arena (an ArenaMap) at load time. Exercises the full arena-load + semantic-validation path under a real `--dry-run`. The arena is DERIVED, never set in JSON.
